cohort: Pregnant women who delivered between May 1, 2020, and August 31, 2020, at a tertiary care center in India, with cases being COVID-19 positive and controls being COVID-19 negative.
finding: The majority of COVID-19 infected pregnant women were asymptomatic and had mild disease, with no significant adverse maternal or neonatal outcomes compared to controls, except for higher rates of medical and pregnancy morbidity and longer hospital stays.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery rates were higher in COVID-19 positive women (52.49%) compared to controls (33%).
gest_age: Mean gestational age was 38.1 weeks for mild cases and 37.5 weeks for moderate/severe cases.
birth_weight: Mean birth weight was 2.7 +/- 0.59 kg in cases and 2.5 +/- 0.56 kg in controls.
